definitions.full: H495. Ellasar אֶלָּסָר proper name, of a location Ellasar Gen 14:1 , 9 (= Babylonian Larsa, modern Senkereh , approximately 28 miles northeast from Ur; compare Loft CS 240 f Dl Pa 223 f Tiele Geschichte i. 86 , COT on the passage ).
